title: 第七章混沌巨神原始超越之神诸果第一因新书求推荐票求收藏第八章你好王璃明天见新书求推荐票求收藏
slug: 这年头谁还不是个武者啊
content_zh:
第七章混沌巨神，原始超越之神，诸果第一因！
【新书，求推荐票，求收藏】
随着王璃选择“确认”
一瞬间，系统似乎暂停了几瞬。
就在王璃以为这系统是不是又出来什么智障故障的时候，在王璃的眼前出现了某种宏伟、绚烂、至高又无可名状的宏伟幻象！
他看到了浩瀚无垠的虚空海洋，无尽世界群环绕漂浮不定。
王璃的心头却不知何时，又有丝丝心悸在蠕动。
他再次抬头，那一瞬间，在那以那抹倒影为核心的浩瀚海洋里，只见在那无尽，一片片，一座座，一方方晦暗的多元世界，在相互并接，彼此互连，共同组成了一座座庞大到无法形容的伟岸“星座”
而在这些“星座”
之后，一座极尽恢宏璀璨，不知高远，不知大小，如似无尽座宇宙一起拼接垒成的圣山，若隐若现。
圣山上，一尊尊神明遥望时光彼端，冷漠如命运，似乎完全没有看到在某个不知隔断了多少世界时空的未知宇宙的一小角落，正有一个普通生命不经意间看到了祂们。
这一刻，一方方“星座”
仿佛活了过来，如神明，似魔怪，仿佛神器，都在朝着王璃呼唤，发出最竭尽全力的震天嘶吼！
选我！
选我！
选我！
选我！
那是一种无需言语表达的强烈，是一种令周围的一切黯淡的纯粹！
嘈杂无边的声音完全萦绕在王璃的心田，想要遮住耳朵都不行。
那些声音不断压迫着王璃，止不断，停不住，仿佛只要王璃不做出选择，它们就能叫喊到宇宙尽头，时光终焉！

王璃被这些声音吵的耳朵都“嗡嗡嗡”
的，心烦意乱，气跳不止，火气就跟自家农家乐里的燃气灶似的，“噌”
得一下就上来了，止都止不住。
他捂着耳朵，终于忍不住大吼了一声：“都TM给我闭嘴！
我要选也不选你们这些酸黄瓜，裂破枣。
也不看看，你们都长得啥样！
我就是要选，我也不选你们啊。
content_en:
Chapter 7 The Titan of Chaos, the original god of transcendence, the first cause of all effects!
[New book, please vote for recommendation, please collect]
As Wang Li selects "Confirm"
For a moment, the system seemed to pause for a few seconds.
Just when Wang Li thought that there was another mental failure in the system, some kind of magnificent, gorgeous, supreme and indescribable grand illusion appeared in front of Wang Li's eyes!
He saw the vast ocean of void, surrounded by endless floating worlds.
Wang Li didn't know when, but there was a trace of palpitations squirming in Wang Li's heart.
He looked up again, and at that moment, in the vast ocean with that reflection as the core, he saw endless, patchy, dark, diverse worlds, connecting and interconnecting with each other, forming a series of indescribably huge "constellations"
And in these "constellations"
Afterwards, an extremely majestic and dazzling mountain with no idea of height or size, like a holy mountain made up of endless universes spliced together, loomed.
On the holy mountain, the gods looked at the other side of time, as indifferent as fate, as if they did not see at all that in a small corner of the unknown universe that separated countless worlds of time and space, there was an ordinary being who inadvertently saw them.
At this moment, all the "constellations"
It seemed as if it had come to life, like a god, like a monster, like an artifact, all calling towards Wang Li, letting out the loudest roar possible!
Choose me!
Choose me!
Choose me!
Choose me!
It is a kind of intensity that needs no words to express, a kind of purity that makes everything around it dim!
The noisy and boundless sound completely lingered in Wang Li's heart, and it was impossible to cover his ears.
Those voices kept oppressing Wang Li, unable to stop, as if as long as Wang Li didn't make a choice, they could scream to the end of the universe and the end of time!
Wang Li's ears were buzzing from the noise.
Yes, I was upset, and I couldn’t stop being angry. I was as angry as the gas stove in my farmhouse, “噌”
It came right up and I couldn't stop.
He covered his ears and finally couldn't help shouting: "Shut up!
If I want to choose, I won’t choose you pickled cucumbers and cracked dates.
Don’t even look at what you all look like!
Even if I want to choose, I won’t choose you either.
